title: At the doctor's
es: Describir síntomas y entender indicaciones médicas
goal: Explicar cómo te sientes, desde cuándo, y entender recomendaciones.
phrases: I've had a headache since Monday.
Tengo dolor de cabeza desde el lunes.
How often should I take it?

turns.t: Good morning, please take a seat. So, what seems to be the problem today?
turns.es: Buenos días, siéntese. ¿Cuál parece ser el problema hoy?

y.say: I've had a sore throat and a cough since Monday, and I feel very tired.
y.es: Tengo dolor de garganta y tos desde el lunes y me siento muy cansado.
alts: My throat hurts and I have had a cough since Monday. I am very tired.

turns.t: I see. Have you had a fever, or any trouble breathing? Also, are you taking any medication at the moment?
turns.es: Entiendo. ¿Ha tenido fiebre o problemas para respirar? ¿Toma algún medicamento ahora?

y.say: No fever, and I can breathe normally. I'm not taking any medication, but I'm allergic to penicillin.
y.es: Sin fiebre y respiro normal. No tomo medicación, pero soy alérgico a la penicilina.
alts: I don't have a fever and I breathe fine. I don't take medicine. I have an allergy to penicillin.

c.q: What is important the patient tells the doctor?

turns.t: Thank you, that's very useful. It looks like a viral infection, so antibiotics won't help. I'll give you something for the throat. Take one tablet three times a day, after meals, for five days. Drink plenty of water and get as much rest as you can.
turns.es: Gracias, es muy útil. Parece una infección viral, así que los antibióticos no ayudarían. Le daré algo para la garganta. Una pastilla tres veces al día, después de comer, durante cinco días. Beba mucha agua y descanse.

c.q: How often should he take the tablet?

y.say: So I should take one tablet three times a day after meals, and drink a lot of water.
y.es: Entonces debo tomar una pastilla tres veces al día después de comer y beber mucha agua.
alts: I have to take a pill three times a day after eating and drink lots of water.

turns.t: Exactly. If you're not feeling better in a week, or if you develop a fever, come back and see me. Would you like a doctor's note for work?
turns.es: Exacto. Si no mejora en una semana o le da fiebre, vuelva. ¿Quiere un justificante para el trabajo?

y.say: Yes, please. I need to stay at home for two days. Thank you very much, doctor.
y.es: Sí, por favor. Necesito quedarme en casa dos días. Muchas gracias, doctor.
alts: Yes please, I have to stay home for two days. Thanks a lot doctor.

turns.t: Of course. Before you go, a few quick questions about your lifestyle, because they can affect how fast you recover. Do you smoke, and do you do any exercise?
turns.es: Claro. Antes de irse, unas preguntas sobre su estilo de vida, porque pueden afectar la recuperación. ¿Fuma? ¿Hace ejercicio?

y.say: I don't smoke, and I usually exercise twice a week, but I'll rest until I feel better.
y.es: No fumo y suelo hacer ejercicio dos veces por semana, pero descansaré hasta sentirme mejor.
alts: I do not smoke. I exercise two times a week but I will rest until I am better.

turns.t: That's sensible. The pharmacy is on the ground floor and it closes at seven, so please pick up your tablets today. Do you have any other questions for me?
turns.es: Es sensato. La farmacia está en la planta baja y cierra a las siete, así que recoja hoy las pastillas. ¿Tiene alguna otra pregunta?

y.say: Yes, can I drink coffee while I'm taking the tablets? And is it okay to go to work on Friday?
y.es: Sí, ¿puedo tomar café mientras tomo las pastillas? ¿Y puedo ir a trabajar el viernes?
alts: Can I have coffee with the tablets? And can I go to work on Friday?
